title: A Python AI Tool Was Just Booby-Trapped With Key-Stealing Malware
description: Real Python's weekly AI news for October 17–23, 2026, explained in plain language: a booby-trapped Python AI tool, a PHP security fix, and PyTorch on TPUs.
summary: Real Python AI News · Weekly edition · The week of October 17–23, 2026 Stop Falling Behind on AI. New models, new prices, new agent tools, all the time.
takeaways: New models, new prices, new agent tools, all the time.

A tainted LiteLLM update hands attackers passwords and keys Many companies that build with AI rely on LiteLLM , a free tool that connects their software to dozens of AI models through a single gateway.
Every copy on PyPI , the public catalog where Python programmers download add-on tools, and in its Docker images , packaged copies for servers, carries hidden malicious code.
